title: Word Formation: Przeczenia: un- i in- (krok 2: przedrostki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Kazde zdanie potrzebuje przedrostka, ktory odwraca znaczenie wyrazu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna.

items.sentence: Germs are __________ to the naked eye.
Three of your answers were __________, so try them again.
The ending of the film was completely __________.
I am afraid I am __________ to help you this afternoon.
The meeting was __________, so nobody wore a suit.
It was __________ of him to laugh at her mistake.
The flight was __________ - we had to change in Paris.
The children were __________ with their new school.
